description: Source code for LiteLLMHandler class that interfaces with the LiteLLM API, handling message creation, prompt completion, and model-specific logic such as model detection, signature injection, and streaming responses.

classes.name: LiteLLMHandler
classes.description: A handler class that proxies requests to various LLM providers via the LiteLLM API, following the OpenAI API format for compatibility.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the handler with provided options, setting default URL, API key, model ID, and default model info.

methods.name: isGpt5
methods.description: Detects if the given model ID corresponds to a GPT-5 model based on naming pattern.

methods.name: isGeminiModel
methods.description: Detects if the model ID corresponds to a Gemini model requiring thought signature handling.

methods.name: injectThoughtSignatureForGemini
methods.description: Injects dummy thought signatures into tool calls for Gemini models to satisfy API validation.

methods.name: createMessage
methods.description: Creates a streaming message response, handling cache control, model-specific parameters, and signature injection for Gemini models.

methods.name: completePrompt
methods.description: Completes a prompt with the specified model, handling max tokens for GPT-5 models.
